notes: This is an evidence checklist, not an automatic aesthetic classifier or release certification. Existing GC UI token/component authority remains unchanged.

criteria.title: Product identity
criteria.expectation: Distinctive product-specific identity without interchangeable SaaS treatment

criteria.title: Application shell
criteria.expectation: Intentional sidebar, titlebar, window chrome, toolbar and content hierarchy

criteria.title: Typography
criteria.expectation: Clear typographic roles, optical alignment, wrapping and readable scale

criteria.title: Spacing and proportions
criteria.expectation: Token-governed rhythm, balanced density and precise alignment

criteria.title: Design-system integrity
criteria.expectation: Verified GC UI tokens, components and approved patterns; no arbitrary branding

criteria.title: Information hierarchy
criteria.expectation: Recognizable primary tasks, meaningful content grouping and visual focal points

criteria.title: Color and materials
criteria.expectation: Semantic contrast and purposeful Canvas, Surface and optional Lens

criteria.title: Depth and layering
criteria.expectation: Restrained coherent elevation without decorative shadow or glow overload

criteria.title: Navigation quality
criteria.expectation: Floating app-controlled nav, discernible active state, clear grouping and reachability

criteria.title: Iconography
criteria.expectation: Coherent original glyph treatment, optical sizing and accessible labels

criteria.title: Layout originality
criteria.expectation: Workflow-specific arrangements; no unjustified repetitive card farm

criteria.title: Microinteraction polish
criteria.expectation: Trustworthy hover, press, focus, selected, disabled and busy feedback

criteria.title: Motion language
criteria.expectation: Purposeful transition timing with accessible reduced-motion alternative

criteria.title: Component finish
criteria.expectation: Refined buttons, inputs, tables, menus, dialogs and window controls

criteria.title: Non-ideal states
criteria.expectation: Designed empty, loading, error, offline, denied and recovery workflows where applicable

criteria.title: Authentic imagery
criteria.expectation: Purposeful original and licensed assets; no generic emoji or deceptive placeholders

criteria.title: Responsive and native fit
criteria.expectation: Real platform layouts, window resizing, breakpoints, safe areas and text zoom

criteria.title: Pixel-level precision
criteria.expectation: Aligned baselines, consistent radii, borders, clipping and visual details

criteria.title: Content authenticity
criteria.expectation: Relevant real or clearly labeled sample data; no fictional telemetry or inert controls

criteria.title: Rendered visual audit
criteria.expectation: Whole-workflow screenshot-led inspection, corrective iteration and reviewer disposition
